# recht.nrw.de fixtures (BE-59)

Unchanged public pages from https://recht.nrw.de captured 2026-11-17 (robots.txt
permits them; one request at a time). Official NRW legal texts and metadata; see
the portal's Impressum for terms.

- `gesetz_2004_pdf.html`: newest version (31.01.2004) of the Abgeordnetengesetz
  AbgG NW, a long numeric-date amendment history with three linked citations.
- `gesetz_2000_pdf.html`: its 01.01.2000 version (lists the other versions).
- `gesetz_2025.html`: Abrechnungsfondsgesetz, version of 01.01.2025, one linked
  amendment (GV. NRW. 2024 S. 1220) and an unlinked original citation.
- `verordnung_2024.html`: an ordinance whose first history clause links its own
  promulgation (GV. NRW. 2024 S. 1140) and whose repeal is not linked.
- `sitemap.xml` / `sitemap_page.xml`: a reduced sitemap index and page holding
  the real `<url>` entries for every version of these three acts plus one
  announcement (ignored by the adapter).
